name: ma-cross-border
description: Use this skill for Morocco cross-border tax for tax year 2026: withholding on payments to non-residents under Art. 15, dividends, the Art. 16 flat tax for foreign contractors, territoriality under Art. 5, branches, foreign tax credits under Art. 19 bis and 77, who pays and when. Covers Moroccan payers and non-resident companies. Trigger on phrases like "retenue a la source non resident Maroc", "Morocco withholding tax", "produits bruts article 15", "royalties Morocco", "societe non residente", "imposition forfaitaire 8%", "convention fiscale Maroc", "credit d'impot etranger", "الاقتطاع من المنبع المغرب". Replies in the user's language.
